item: Fault harness: a lab scenario that exports a real diagnostics zip with a real gate hold and pool timeouts
summary: contention-zip: a second process holds SQLite's write lock for 45 s (a real gate_hold of 30.1 s) and a one-connection pool with a zero checkout timeout makes real pool timeouts; the app's own all-diagnostics job is downloaded. OO_FAULT_TREE boots another checkout's src/. Not part of the default run (tests/test_fault_harness.py does not name it). Nothing added to src/.
